newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: BRUSSELS, Nov 14 - Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:

Spokesman Jochen Kubosch said a competitiveness report had been transmitted as a working document to the Industry Council following the Commission communication on benchmarking competitive performances.

He aslo announced a public conference on the issue of competitiveness on November 19, organised jointly bu UNICE and the Commission which will be attended by Commissioner Martin Bangemann. He said registration forms would be available in his office.
Kubosch also said the Court of Justice's decisions were available in his office.

In answer to a question, spokesman Gerard Kieley said the Veterinary Committee had proposed banning South-African ostrich meat following an outbreak of a new disease called Crimean-Congo fever. Kieley said the Commission would also examine the situation in other African States but did not envisage a ban on British ostrich meat.
Spokeswoman Sarah Lambert said German authorities had sought informal Commission advice on the privatisation of Deutsche Lufthansa.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/1022: TACIS action programme 1996 for Ukraine.
- IP/96/1023: Aerial photography: infringement proceedings against Belgium for excessive restrictions.
- IP/96/1024: Follow-up to Rio: The Commission presents communication on the way forward.
- IP/96/1025: Sustainable development in Europe assessed.
- IP/96/1026: Energy consultative committee: openness and transparency for energy policies and actions.
- IP/96/1027: European Union to be present at the 1998 Lisbon World expo.
- Speech/96/284: Extracts of speech by Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan on trade, economic developments and Sino-European relations.
- Speech/96/285: Speech by Commissioner Christos Papoutsis on retail and distribution on the information highways.
- Speech/96/286: Speech by Franz Fischler on world food security.
- Speech/96/287: Speech by Commission President Jacques Santer on "No return to 19th century Dickensian sweat-shops".
- Speech/96/288: Speech by Commissioner Hans van den Broek on peace process in Bosnia-Herzegovina.
- Eurostat, statistics in focus, regions No 1996-3: European labour force survey.
- Eurostat, consumer price index No 1996-10.
- European Economy (french) No 62-1996.
- ME96/14.11: Midday express.
